title: Failure Underlay: Compact Annotator for Error Taxonomy & Payload Timeline
creator: Ava Martinez
summary: Design and prototype a compact, context-dense ‘Failure Underlay’ panel that surfaces a summarised error taxonomy, retry chain, and lightweight payload snapshots inline with the request timeline. Target is quick triage for engineers and PMs without leaving the per-request view.
background: Current request debug views are rich but vertically bulky; teams frequently take multiple navigation steps to correlate error classes with cost and retry behavior. This leads to slower MTTR on intermittent failures and blind spots during rollouts where noisy variants spike costs.
goals: Provide an at-a-glance taxonomy (error class, probable cause, top affected routes)
Show a condensed retry-history timeline with quick-play retry simulation affordance
Expose payload diffs (input/output snippets) for failed and last-successful attempts
Link to cost delta info for failures (token counts + estimated cost impact)
Be compact enough to display as an underlay in the Console request list and request detail panes
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates underlay rendered below request row with toggle open/closed
Taxonomy badges map to existing error categories (network, model-timeout, decode-error, schema-mismatch) and show counts
Retry timeline shows up to 5 recent attempts with timestamp, status, latency, and quick action button (replay or annotate)
Payload snapshots present sanitized input/output snippets with diff highlights and a link to full payload inspector
Cost estimate line computes token delta and approximate cost, matching Optimize tool heuristics
Design reviewed by ENG and PM with actionable feedback logged in comments
design_notes: Use compact badges with 3 color states: info/guardrail/warning; reserve red only for high-severity 'data-loss' categories
Prioritize vertical compression: reduce padding, use condensed type scale for underlay rows
Inline actions: annotate, mark as noise, escalate to dedicated capacity review (links to PM workflow)
Accessibility: badges must have text labels and tooltips; ensure 4.5:1 contrast for critical states
Privacy: payload snapshots are automatically redacted according to PII rules; include a toggle to view raw payload for authorized roles
